entries.text: You see Vree.
entries.source_text: You see Vree.

entries.text: 你看到弗蕾。
entries.source_text: 你看到弗蕾。

entries.text: I'm sorry, you're disrupting my meditation.  Please leave.
entries.source_text: I'm sorry, you're disrupting my meditation.  Please leave.

entries.text: 很抱歉，你打断了我的思考。请离开。
entries.source_text: 很抱歉，你打断了我的思考。请离开。

entries.text: I'm sorry.  I'll come back another time.
entries.source_text: I'm sorry.  I'll come back another time.

entries.text: 对不起。那我等一会再过来。
entries.source_text: 对不起。那我等一会再过来。

entries.text: I'll be back.
entries.source_text: I'll be back.

entries.text: 我会回来的。
entries.source_text: 我会回来的。

entries.text: How could I know your schedule?
entries.source_text: How could I know your schedule?

entries.text: 我怎么知道你什么时间有空？
entries.source_text: 我怎么知道你什么时间有空？

entries.text: Uhhh?.
entries.source_text: Uhhh?.

entries.text: 啊？
entries.source_text: 啊？

entries.text: Don't raise your voice to me.  Do I have to have one of#the Brothers teach you some manners.
entries.source_text:
Don't raise your voice to me.  Do I have to have one of
#the Brothers teach you some manners.

entries.text: 不要对我大喊大叫。要我找位兄弟来教你点礼貌吗。
entries.source_text: 不要对我大喊大叫。要我找位兄弟来教你点礼貌吗。

entries.text: Sorry.
entries.source_text: Sorry.

entries.text: 对不起。
entries.source_text: 对不起。

entries.text: Yeah, ok.  Whatever.
entries.source_text: Yeah, ok.  Whatever.

entries.text: 耶，好啊。随便你。
entries.source_text: 耶，好啊。随便你。

entries.text: Oh, I'm scared.
entries.source_text: Oh, I'm scared.

entries.text: 喔, 我好害怕。
entries.source_text: 喔, 我好害怕。

entries.text: Greetings. It's a fine day for learning. Can I help you?
entries.source_text: Greetings. It's a fine day for learning. Can I help you?

entries.text: 你好。今天是学习的好时候。我可以帮你吗？
entries.source_text: 你好。今天是学习的好时候。我可以帮你吗？

entries.text: I know you're the Master Scribe, but what does that mean?
entries.source_text: I know you're the Master Scribe, but what does that mean?

entries.text: 我知道你是首席研究员，可这称呼是什么意思？
entries.source_text: 我知道你是首席研究员，可这称呼是什么意思？

entries.text: I need some technical information.
entries.source_text: I need some technical information.

entries.text: 我需要一些技术知识。
entries.source_text: 我需要一些技术知识。

entries.text: Uhh . . .
entries.source_text: Uhh . . .

entries.text: I record the knowledge of our ancestors for future generations.
entries.source_text: I record the knowledge of our ancestors for future generations.

entries.text: 我为了未来的后人，记录从我们祖先流传下来的知识。
entries.source_text: 我为了未来的后人，记录从我们祖先流传下来的知识。

entries.text: Interesting.  That means you know stuff.
entries.source_text: Interesting.  That means you know stuff.

entries.text: 有意思，就是说你知道点儿东西。
entries.source_text: 有意思，就是说你知道点儿东西。

entries.text: Yes. I guess you could say I know, 'stuff.'
entries.source_text: Yes. I guess you could say I know, 'stuff.'

entries.text: 是啊。我想你可以说我知道点，“东西。”
entries.source_text: 是啊。我想你可以说我知道点，“东西。”

entries.text: What can I help you with?
entries.source_text: What can I help you with?

entries.text: 我可以帮你些什么？
entries.source_text: 我可以帮你些什么？

entries.text: Go ahead.
entries.source_text: Go ahead.

entries.text: 继续。
entries.source_text: 继续。

entries.text: I need a water-chip repaired. Can you help me?
entries.source_text: I need a water-chip repaired. Can you help me?

entries.text: 我需要一个修好的净水芯片。你能帮我吗？
entries.source_text: 我需要一个修好的净水芯片。你能帮我吗？

entries.text: I'd like to know more about the weapons we make here.
entries.source_text: I'd like to know more about the weapons we make here.

entries.text: 关于我们制造的武器，我想知道更多。
entries.source_text: 关于我们制造的武器，我想知道更多。

entries.text: I heard something about holo-discs, how can I read them?
entries.source_text: I heard something about holo-discs, how can I read them?

entries.text: 我听说过什么全息磁盘，我该怎么读取它们？
entries.source_text: 我听说过什么全息磁盘，我该怎么读取它们？

entries.text: How can I prevent radiation poisoning?
entries.source_text: How can I prevent radiation poisoning?

entries.text: 我要怎样防护辐射中毒？
entries.source_text: 我要怎样防护辐射中毒？

entries.text: What's causing all the mutations?
entries.source_text: What's causing all the mutations?

entries.text: 是什么引发了各种突变？
entries.source_text: 是什么引发了各种突变？

entries.text: Speak to the knights.  Ask them to show you one of#the latest laser pistols I designed.
entries.source_text:
Speak to the knights.  Ask them to show you one of
#the latest laser pistols I designed.

entries.text: 去找骑士们。让他们给你看看我最新设计的激光手枪。
entries.source_text: 去找骑士们。让他们给你看看我最新设计的激光手枪。

entries.text: Thanks!
entries.source_text: Thanks!

entries.text: 谢谢！
entries.source_text: 谢谢！

entries.text: I've got another question . . .
entries.source_text: I've got another question . . .

entries.text: 我还有其它的问题……
entries.source_text: 我还有其它的问题……

entries.text: You are not yet capable of properly using the sacred knowledge.
entries.source_text: You are not yet capable of properly using the sacred knowledge.

entries.text: 你现在还没有能力去完全运用这高深的知识。
entries.source_text: 你现在还没有能力去完全运用这高深的知识。

entries.text: Use your Pip-Boy 2000 to read the discs. Insert the disc into the#reader. If you have the proper computer skills, you should be able#to scan the data.
entries.source_text:
Use your Pip-Boy 2000 to read the discs. Insert the disc into the
#reader. If you have the proper computer skills, you should be able
#to scan the data.

entries.text: 用你的哔哔小子2000来读这些磁盘。把盘放到读取器里。如果你有足够的电脑技术，就可以扫描出数据。
entries.source_text: 用你的哔哔小子2000来读这些磁盘。把盘放到读取器里。如果你有足够的电脑技术，就可以扫描出数据。

entries.text: Where can I learn the computer skills?
entries.source_text: Where can I learn the computer skills?

entries.text: 我在哪可以学到电脑技术？
entries.source_text: 我在哪可以学到电脑技术？

entries.text: Thanks.
entries.source_text: Thanks.

entries.text: 谢谢。
entries.source_text: 谢谢。

entries.text: Can I ask another question?
entries.source_text: Can I ask another question?

entries.text: 我能问别的问题吗？
entries.source_text: 我能问别的问题吗？

entries.text: The Brotherhood has some automated courses that you can take.#Here, I'll show you.
entries.source_text:
The Brotherhood has some automated courses that you can take.
#Here, I'll show you.

entries.text: 兄弟会有一些自动化教程你可以去学习。来这边，我给你演示一下。
entries.source_text: 兄弟会有一些自动化教程你可以去学习。来这边，我给你演示一下。

entries.text: Use this terminal to learn the basics of computer operations.
entries.source_text: Use this terminal to learn the basics of computer operations.

entries.text: 用这个终端来学习基本的电脑操作。
entries.source_text: 用这个终端来学习基本的电脑操作。

entries.text: You're not very bright, are you?  You're wearing a holo disc#reader on your arm.
entries.source_text:
You're not very bright, are you?  You're wearing a holo disc
#reader on your arm.

entries.text: 你不太聪明是吗？你把全息磁盘读取器绑到胳膊上去了。
entries.source_text: 你不太聪明是吗？你把全息磁盘读取器绑到胳膊上去了。

entries.text: You would need some anti-radiation drugs. I have some. Take#these immediately if you think you are near radiation.
entries.source_text:
You would need some anti-radiation drugs. I have some. Take
#these immediately if you think you are near radiation.

entries.text: 你需要些抗辐射药。我这有一点。在你认为自己临近辐射的时候马上服用。
entries.source_text: 你需要些抗辐射药。我这有一点。在你认为自己临近辐射的时候马上服用。

entries.text: Thanks!
entries.source_text: Thanks!

entries.text: 谢谢你！
entries.source_text: 谢谢你！

entries.text: Can I ask you something else?
entries.source_text: Can I ask you something else?

entries.text: 我能问你些别的事情吗？
entries.source_text: 我能问你些别的事情吗？

entries.text: Don't drink the glowing water.
entries.source_text: Don't drink the glowing water.

entries.text: 不要喝发光的水。
entries.source_text: 不要喝发光的水。

entries.text: Between the nuclear and biogenetic weapons used in the War, it's#surprising we don't have more mutations. However, if we can hold#out, everything will be ok.
entries.source_text:
Between the nuclear and biogenetic weapons used in the War, it's
#surprising we don't have more mutations. However, if we can hold
#out, everything will be ok.

entries.text: 很奇怪的，在以前滥用核武器与生物武器的战争中，我们并没有这么多的变异。不管怎样，如果我们能够坚持下去，一切都会好的。
entries.source_text: 很奇怪的，在以前滥用核武器与生物武器的战争中，我们并没有这么多的变异。不管怎样，如果我们能够坚持下去，一切都会好的。

entries.text: Why do you say that?
entries.source_text: Why do you say that?

entries.text: 你为什么这么说？
entries.source_text: 你为什么这么说？

entries.text: You're right. We'll be fine.
entries.source_text: You're right. We'll be fine.

entries.text: 你是对的，我们会好起来的。
entries.source_text: 你是对的，我们会好起来的。

entries.text: I've got another question . . .
entries.source_text: I've got another question . . .

entries.text: 我还有其它的问题……
entries.source_text: 我还有其它的问题……

entries.text: All the mutants I've studied have been sterile - they can't breed with#another creature.  If we could clean up the mutation sources, we#should be able to simply outlive the mutants.
entries.source_text:
All the mutants I've studied have been sterile - they can't breed with
#another creature.  If we could clean up the mutation sources, we
#should be able to simply outlive the mutants.

entries.text: 我研究过的所有变种人都是不育的——他们不能像其他动物一样繁殖。如果我们能够清除变异的源头，我们就是从人种延续方面也能战胜他们。
entries.source_text: 我研究过的所有变种人都是不育的——他们不能像其他动物一样繁殖。如果我们能够清除变异的源头，我们就是从人种延续方面也能战胜他们。

entries.text: Sounds like a plan.
entries.source_text: Sounds like a plan.

entries.text: 听起来是个好主意。
entries.source_text: 听起来是个好主意。

entries.text: Interesting theory. Any proof?
entries.source_text: Interesting theory. Any proof?

entries.text: 有趣的理论，有什么证据？
entries.source_text: 有趣的理论，有什么证据？

entries.text: I've got another question . . .
entries.source_text: I've got another question . . .

entries.text: 我还有其它的问题……
entries.source_text: 我还有其它的问题……

entries.text: Here, take this holo-disc, it's got copies of my autopsies on mutant#corpses.  It clearly shows that no mutant could possibly reproduce successfully.
entries.source_text:
Here, take this holo-disc, it's got copies of my autopsies on mutant
#corpses.  It clearly shows that no mutant could possibly reproduce successfully.

entries.text: 给，拿着这张全息磁盘，上面有我解剖变种人尸体的资料副本。它清楚的说明了没有任何变种人可以成功的繁殖。
entries.source_text: 给，拿着这张全息磁盘，上面有我解剖变种人尸体的资料副本。它清楚的说明了没有任何变种人可以成功的繁殖。

entries.text: Thanks.
entries.source_text: Thanks.

entries.text: 谢谢。
entries.source_text: 谢谢。

entries.text: Can I ask something else?
entries.source_text: Can I ask something else?

entries.text: 我能问你些别的事情吗？
entries.source_text: 我能问你些别的事情吗？

entries.text: I don't think I should tell you anything.  Perhaps later, if you#prove yourself to the Brotherhood's cause.
entries.source_text:
I don't think I should tell you anything.  Perhaps later, if you
#prove yourself to the Brotherhood's cause.

entries.text: 我想我不会告诉你任何事。或许以后，在你为兄弟会的事业做出了贡献后再说。
entries.source_text: 我想我不会告诉你任何事。或许以后，在你为兄弟会的事业做出了贡献后再说。

entries.text: I'm quite certain you're in the wrong place. Please leave, I'm rather#busy.
entries.source_text:
I'm quite certain you're in the wrong place. Please leave, I'm rather
#busy.

entries.text: 我很确定你来错地方了。请离开，我非常忙。
entries.source_text: 我很确定你来错地方了。请离开，我非常忙。

entries.text: You will destroy the knowledge that can save the world!
entries.source_text: You will destroy the knowledge that can save the world!

entries.text: 你将毁灭掉能够拯救世界的知识！
entries.source_text: 你将毁灭掉能够拯救世界的知识！

entries.text: Yeah, starting with you.
entries.source_text: Yeah, starting with you.

entries.text: 耶，从你开始。
entries.source_text: 耶，从你开始。

entries.text: No. I'm stopping those who could bring about another nuclear war.
entries.source_text: No. I'm stopping those who could bring about another nuclear war.

entries.text: 不。我在阻止那些会引发另一场核战争的人。
entries.source_text: 不。我在阻止那些会引发另一场核战争的人。

entries.text: Never! The Brotherhood will see that it never happens again!
entries.source_text: Never! The Brotherhood will see that it never happens again!

entries.text: 决不！兄弟会绝不会眼看这个再次发生！
entries.source_text: 决不！兄弟会绝不会眼看这个再次发生！

entries.text: That's what they all say . . . except you. You'll be dead.
entries.source_text: That's what they all say . . . except you. You'll be dead.

entries.text: 他们都是这样说……不单单是你。你将会死。
entries.source_text: 他们都是这样说……不单单是你。你将会死。

entries.text: What can I help you with?
entries.source_text: What can I help you with?

entries.text: 我可以帮你些什么。
entries.source_text: 我可以帮你些什么。

entries.text: I've got some important news to tell you about Kedrick. He's a traitor.
entries.source_text: I've got some important news to tell you about Kedrick. He's a traitor.

entries.text: 我有一些重要的消息来告诉你。凯德里克，他是个叛徒。
entries.source_text: 我有一些重要的消息来告诉你。凯德里克，他是个叛徒。

entries.text: What you would do if there was corruption within the Brotherhood.
entries.source_text: What you would do if there was corruption within the Brotherhood.

entries.text: 如果兄弟会内出现腐败你将会怎么做。
entries.source_text: 如果兄弟会内出现腐败你将会怎么做。

entries.text: Nuhh. Nuh-uh-nuh!
entries.source_text: Nuhh. Nuh-uh-nuh!

entries.text: 啊。啊－啊－啊！
entries.source_text: 啊。啊－啊－啊！

entries.text: Very good. I really can tell the lessons have helped.
entries.source_text: Very good. I really can tell the lessons have helped.

entries.text: 很好。我可以说这些课程会很有帮助。
entries.source_text: 很好。我可以说这些课程会很有帮助。

entries.text: Kedrick? He's been a loyal member of the Brotherhood forever. I#doubt you would even know what that means.
entries.source_text:
Kedrick? He's been a loyal member of the Brotherhood forever. I
#doubt you would even know what that means.

entries.text: 凯德里克？他永远是兄弟会忠诚的一员。我怀疑你甚至不明白这意味着什么。
entries.source_text: 凯德里克？他永远是兄弟会忠诚的一员。我怀疑你甚至不明白这意味着什么。

entries.text: Yeah, I do. Kedrick is a traitor and planning to overthrow your#leaders.
entries.source_text:
Yeah, I do. Kedrick is a traitor and planning to overthrow your
#leaders.

entries.text: 耶，是的。凯德里克是个叛徒，而且计划推翻你们的领导者。
entries.source_text: 耶，是的。凯德里克是个叛徒，而且计划推翻你们的领导者。

entries.text: Maybe so.
entries.source_text: Maybe so.

entries.text: 可能是这样。
entries.source_text: 可能是这样。

entries.text: You're certain of this? Perhaps we should go talk to the High Elder.
entries.source_text: You're certain of this? Perhaps we should go talk to the High Elder.

entries.text: 你很确定？或许我们应该去向高级元老汇报。
entries.source_text: 你很确定？或许我们应该去向高级元老汇报。

entries.text: Do not bother me with innuendo. Bring proof to the High Elder, or#say nothing of this.
entries.source_text:
Do not bother me with innuendo. Bring proof to the High Elder, or
#say nothing of this.

entries.text: 不要传播谣言。要么向高级元老出示证据，要么什么都别说。
entries.source_text: 不要传播谣言。要么向高级元老出示证据，要么什么都别说。

entries.text: Do what must be done. Stamp out the heresy and remove those#responsible for the stain.
entries.source_text:
Do what must be done. Stamp out the heresy and remove those
#responsible for the stain.

entries.text: 此事由你便宜办理。消灭异心之人，根除污点之源。
entries.source_text: 此事由你便宜办理。消灭异心之人，根除污点之源。

entries.text: Even if it was a trusted member of the Brotherhood.
entries.source_text: Even if it was a trusted member of the Brotherhood.

entries.text: 即便他曾是兄弟会可以信赖的成员。
entries.source_text: 即便他曾是兄弟会可以信赖的成员。

entries.text: And who would do the removal?
entries.source_text: And who would do the removal?

entries.text: 那么谁来做清除工作？
entries.source_text: 那么谁来做清除工作？

entries.text: Even so.  But proof would have to be offered.
entries.source_text: Even so.  But proof would have to be offered.

entries.text: 虽然如此。但还是需要证据。
entries.source_text: 虽然如此。但还是需要证据。

entries.text: Kedrick is a traitor. He is planning on killing the Elders.
entries.source_text: Kedrick is a traitor. He is planning on killing the Elders.

entries.text: 凯德里克是个叛徒。他正在计划杀掉元老们。
entries.source_text: 凯德里克是个叛徒。他正在计划杀掉元老们。

entries.text: I'll get the proof.
entries.source_text: I'll get the proof.

entries.text: 我去找证据。
entries.source_text: 我去找证据。

entries.text: Then we must go to the High Elder. Bring your proof and we'll go#talk to him.
entries.source_text:
Then we must go to the High Elder. Bring your proof and we'll go
#talk to him.

entries.text: 然后我们必须去找高级元老。带着你的证据向他汇报。
entries.source_text: 然后我们必须去找高级元老。带着你的证据向他汇报。

entries.text: The High Elder and Rhombus, of course.
entries.source_text: The High Elder and Rhombus, of course.

entries.text: 当然是高级元老和隆伯斯。
entries.source_text: 当然是高级元老和隆伯斯。

entries.text: Did you hear about the missing Initiate? This is terrible!
entries.source_text: Did you hear about the missing Initiate? This is terrible!

entries.text: 你听说过关于失踪的新兵的事吗？太可怕了！
entries.source_text: 你听说过关于失踪的新兵的事吗？太可怕了！

entries.text: I agree.
entries.source_text: I agree.

entries.text: 我同意。
entries.source_text: 我同意。

entries.text: Nuh-huh.
entries.source_text: Nuh-huh.

entries.text: 啊-啊。
entries.source_text: 啊-啊。

entries.text: If you can help him, I would be most grateful.
entries.source_text: If you can help him, I would be most grateful.

entries.text: 如果你能帮助他，我将十分感激。
entries.source_text: 如果你能帮助他，我将十分感激。

entries.text: Good deeds should be rewarded. For helping the Initiate, please take#these.
entries.source_text:
Good deeds should be rewarded. For helping the Initiate, please take
#these.

entries.text: 好的行为应当受到奖励。你帮助了新兵，请收下这个。
entries.source_text: 好的行为应当受到奖励。你帮助了新兵，请收下这个。

entries.text: Oh, it's you. What do you want?
entries.source_text: Oh, it's you. What do you want?

entries.text: 喔，是你。你需要什么？
entries.source_text: 喔，是你。你需要什么？

entries.text: I came to apologize.
entries.source_text: I came to apologize.

entries.text: 我是来道歉的。
entries.source_text: 我是来道歉的。

entries.text: Sorry, wrong room.
entries.source_text: Sorry, wrong room.

entries.text: 对不起，走错房间了。
entries.source_text: 对不起，走错房间了。

entries.text: Thank you for your apology.
entries.source_text: Thank you for your apology.

entries.text: 谢谢你的道歉。
entries.source_text: 谢谢你的道歉。

entries.text: Good day.
entries.source_text: Good day.

entries.text: 日安。
entries.source_text: 日安。

entries.text: 谁？等等，这个名字很熟悉。他可能是某些变种人的领袖。
entries.source_text: 谁？等等，这个名字很熟悉。他可能是某些变种人的领袖。

entries.text: I assume you're referring to the last nuclear war. The Brotherhood is doing#everything it can to restore that which was lost.

entries.text: 我想你指的是最后的核战。兄弟会正在做一切努力来使我们曾失去的得以恢复。
